result.rationale: The finding accurately cites the diff: admin-embedding.js.es6 defines saveChanges() calling embedding.update({}), routes.rb maps PUT customize/embedding to embedding#update, and embedding_controller.rb#update only re-renders the serialized object without persisting anything. The template embedding.hbs also has no saveChanges-bound button, so this is not a currently reachable user-facing defect. It is a concrete incomplete-implementation/scope risk: an endpoint returning success without persisting can cause silent data loss if the action is later wired to the UI.
